verdicts.explanation: The bulk ~10^-3 S cm-1 value sits in a garbled Table 1 conductivity cell with a single reference [13], and the paper never states it belongs to the solid-state Li0.33La0.57TiO3 row rather than the sol-gel row. The record's own notes admit the row mapping is by position only, so the material assignment cannot be verified.

The total ~10^-5 S cm-1 value has the same problem: it is in the garbled Table 1 conductivity column, and the paper does not explicitly link it to the solid-state Li0.33La0.57TiO3 row instead of the sol-gel row. Material assignment is unverifiable.

The value 1.2 10−2 S cm-1 appears in the garbled table with no adjacent Li10GeP2S12 label; the only nearby reference is [16], an atomistic simulation, and the paper's text never mentions this conductivity. The material-to-value mapping is inferred, so it cannot be confirmed.
